title: UAlbany nets 2026 commit Tyler Jones - NewsBreak
text:
By No media credit provided. ,
1 hours ago
ALBANY, NY ( NEWS10 ) — College basketball head coaches have to be focused on not just the upcoming season, but the long-term future of the program. UAlbany’s Dwayne Killings is doing just that, already landing a big recruit not for this season, but for 2026.
The Great Danes got a verbal commitment last week from Tyler Jones, a three-star recruit from Memphis, Tennessee. The 6’4 guard averaged eight points and three assists per game in his junior year at the Christ School in North Carolina. He’s rated as a top 50 shooting guard in the country.
Jones says UAlbany was the right fit for him. “I’d definitely say throughout the whole process they recruited me hard,” said Jones. “They really wanted me. When I finally got to get down there, it just felt like home. The coaches welcomed me. Even when I was with the team, they welcomed me and it just felt great.”
He believes he’ll also be a great fit for the Great Danes. “I feel like I can make an impact when I first get there,” said Jones. “They like to play fast and that’s a big part of my game. I like to get out, get my guys involved and go dominate and I feel like that was a big part part for me.”
